text:
jessica: Quick heads-up — hitting a parity bug between Node SDK and REST. REST supports GET /models?include_private=true but client.listModels({ includePrivate: true }) only returns public models. Repro steps in the onboarding sample app. Anyone tracking?

mike: ugh saw that earlier. Sample app hit this when we tried to list a customer's private models during onboarding flow.

sam: can you paste the curl + node snippets? i'll try locally.

jessica: curl example: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood-inference/v1/models?include_private=true"
```
Node sdk call we used: 
```js
const models = await client.listModels({ includePrivate: true });
console.log(models.length); // returns only public list
```

mike: looks like param name mapping is the culprit — sdk expects `include_private` (snake_case) but JS wrapper is sending `includePrivate` to the transport layer and the server ignores it. I think code that marshals params doesn't transform that endpoint.

kevin: also noticed retry behavior difference: when REST returns 429 during list pagination the sample app simply stops; SDK retries automatically which masked the issue in other tests. That led to inconsistent results when combined with the param bug.

marie: if SDK retries, but endpoint isn't idempotent for some calls (eg duplicate import jobs), that's dangerous. We should check which endpoints have idempotency guarantees.

mike: agreed. Plan: 1) quick fix for param normalization in Node SDK, 2) add a test exercising include_private query, 3) audit retry policy for list/create endpoints. I'll open the PR.

alin: to add: sample app currently uses `listModels({ includePrivate: true })` in a few places. Sam, can you grep and update if needed so docs don't show the broken pattern?

sam: on it. i'll patch sample app and add explicit curl examples in the quickstart so it's clear how the query param looks over REST.

jessica: also found a small logging quirk — when server ignores unknown query params it doesn't surface a warning. Could be helpful to return a `ignored_query_params` entry in debug mode. Not required but would speed DX.

kevin: filed an audit ticket for retry policy consistency across SDKs. linking here: INF-2134.

sdk-bot: Created issue INF-2134: "SDK/REST parity: model list query param handling and retry policy audit" <https://redwood.internal/INF-2134> :white_check_mark:

mike: assigning INF-2134 to @mike, putting a small PR up today. will add unit tests and update CHANGELOG.

jessica: thanks. sam/kevin please sync once patches are live so we can update onboarding sample and the quickstart. :thumbsup:

sam: noted. i'll add a short note in the quickstart about the param name mismatch and show both curl + node examples.

marie: can we also add an integration test that runs the quickstart flow on CI? would catch regressions early.

kevin: +1. I'll scope a CI job that runs the sample app against staging for the list/create paths.

jessica: great. leaving this thread open until PR is merged. Thanks all. :sparkles:
